text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with an update on the terms of reference for the Environmental, Social and Governance Committee.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the terms of reference for the Environmental, Social and Governance Committee, as noted in Attachment 1 to the report (April 12, 2021) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Appointed Kathleen Sharpe to the Environmental, Social and Governance Committee.
